Mapped to UTM international postgraduate mainstream Engineering research fee.
Two (2) semester / intake in a year. (February and September)
UTM international registration page lists passport, academic certificates, academic transcripts and health declaration among required documents.

UTM official entry requirement for Master by Mixed-Mode and Research programme: CPA Scale of 4 at 2.75 or higher requires no working experience; 2.50 < CPA < 2.75 is subject to rigorous internal assessment; CPA below 2.50 requires 5 years working experience in the related field.

UTM official postgraduate English requirement: MUET overall band 4.0, IELTS overall band 6.0, TOEFL iBT overall score 60, PTE Academic overall score 59, Cambridge English Qualification overall score 169, or Certified Intensive English Programme (CIEP - ELS) complete level 109 and above.
